order: second follow-up order of 7 October 2026 (evening), G4: the candidate-list test of the proposal 'Diagnostic and proposal: an actions layer for stock selection' (sections 'How a stock gets selected' and 'Pass rules'), registered before the run
status: REGISTERED - committed with its sha256 before any run; the run follows in the same commit series
data_label: free data, members with prices only: the price provider has no bars for delisted members; the coverage table of G2 is reported with the result. A pass on free data stays out of the score until it is confirmed on Sharadar or Norgate (owner-approved, paid; no key stored)
universe: S&P 500 members at each month-end from data/analyst/sp500_membership_history.parquet (June 2004 to date: the fja05680/sp500 components list to the first Wikipedia revision of 2012, Wikipedia revisions after), tickers mapped to their current symbols through data/analyst/ticker_changes.csv. No filter that uses today's list or today's labels (current_universe_only off; a run that sets it is CRITICAL analyst:lookahead_filter).

variables.primary: the 43 (ext43: 21 price variables and 22 fundamentals from EDGAR company facts, scripts/analyst/features_ext.py). Names without fundamentals are left out of the 43-variable model
variables.beside: the 21 price variables alone, trained from January 2005

score: the mean of the within-month percentile ranks of two predictions: the ridge and the harness's boosted tree
target: the within-month percentile rank of the 12-month return (primary); the excess return over the average member is reported beside it
boosted_tree: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf=100, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0), frozen
training: expanding window from June 2010 for the 43 variables (the first month-ends with fundamentals for most members), from January 2005 for the 21 price variables; only month-ends whose 12-month outcome ended before the test year; retrained each January

portfolio.primary: top tenth, equal weight, formed every month
portfolio.beside: formed at quarter-ends only (the proposal re-scores each quarter)

cost: 10 bps a trade, both ways (20 bps per holding)
statistic: Newey-West t on the series of top-tenth excess over the average member: 11 lags for monthly formation, 3 for quarter-end formation
pass_rule: top tenth more than 2 points a year above the average member after costs, t above 3, and a paired difference against the 12-1 momentum top tenth that is positive with t above 2
checks: placebo shifts of +12 and -12 months on all 43 variables (the effect should rise with values from the future and fall toward zero with values from the past)
no row after the month-end enters that month (tests/test_analyst_lookahead.py)
if_it_fails: the candidate list is retired; the proposal's fallback is the 50 largest members
expected_result: on the evidence of the reconciliation correction (the 43 variables trained from June 2010 give t about 2 in the design workspace), the test is expected to fail the t rule; the registered run decides
do_not_touch: once the run begins nothing above changes; a change needs a new registration with a stated reason and both results are reported
